description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume Stamina to deal Havoc DMG.
Hold Basic Attack to enter Rocksteady Defense.

Rocksteady Defense

- Taoqi's damage taken is reduced by 35%;
- When Taoqi is attacked during Rocksteady Defense, she will cast Strategic Parry;
- Strategic Parry is automatically cast after Rocksteady Defense lasts for 3s;
If Taoqi is attacked when casting Resonance Skill Fortified Defense, Strategic Parry is automatically cast.

Strategic Parry

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Mid-Air Attack

Consume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi Stamina untuk memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tahan Basic Attack untuk memasuki Rocksteady Defense.

Rocksteady Defense

- Damage yang diterima Taoqi berkurang 35%;
- Saat Taoqi diserang selama Rocksteady Defense, ia akan melakukan Strategic Parry;
- Strategic Parry dilakukan secara otomatis setelah Rocksteady Defense berlangsung selama 3 dtk;
Jika Taoqi diserang saat menggunakan Resonance Skill Fortified Defense, Strategic Parry dilakukan secara otomatis.

Strategic Parry

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Mid-Air Attack

Mengonsumsi Stamina untuk melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en:
Taoqi deals Havoc DMG to surrounding targets, generating 3 Rocksteady Shield and healing herself.
If attacked when casting Fortified Defense, Strategic Parry will be automatically cast.

Rocksteady Shield

When the active character on the team is attacked, 1 Rocksteady Shield is consumed to reduce the damage taken.
description.id:
Taoqi memberikan Havoc DMG ke target di sekitar, menghasilkan 3 Rocksteady Shield dan memulihkan HP dirinya sendiri.
Jika diserang saat menggunakan Fortified Defense, Strategic Parry akan dilakukan secara otomatis.

Rocksteady Shield

Saat karakter aktif dalam tim diserang, 1 Rocksteady Shield dikonsumsi untuk mengurangi damage yang diterima.

description.en: Attack the target based on Taoqi's DEF, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id: Menyerang target berdasarkan DEF Taoqi, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: While Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield lasts, the Character's DEF is increased by 15%.
description.id: Selama Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield berlangsung, DEF karakter meningkat sebesar 15%.

description.en: After Heavy Attack Strategic Parry is successfully triggered, 25 STA is recovered.
description.id: Setelah Heavy Attack Strategic Parry berhasil terpicu, memulihkan 25 STA.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Timed Counters

When carrying "Resolving Caliber", use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack Strategic Parry or Intro Skill Defense Formation to cast Timed Counters, performing up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
Timed Counters consume 1 "Resolving Caliber" upon hitting an enemy to grant a shield.
After casting the Intro Skill Defense Formation, use Basic Attack to directly cast Timed Counters.

Resolving Caliber

Taoqi can hold up to 3 Resolving Caliber.
Basic Attack 4 will consume all of Taoqi's "Rocksteady Shields" to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".
While Rocksteady Shield exists, when the active character is attacked, 1 "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to recover "Resolving Caliber".
After Rocksteady Shield ends, all remaining "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".
description.id:
Timed Counters

Saat membawa "Resolving Caliber", gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack Strategic Parry atau Intro Skill Defense Formation untuk melakukan Timed Counters, melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Timed Counters mengonsumsi 1 "Resolving Caliber" saat mengenai musuh untuk memberikan shield.
Setelah menggunakan Intro Skill Defense Formation, gunakan Basic Attack untuk langsung melakukan Timed Counters.

Resolving Caliber

Taoqi dapat menyimpan hingga 3 Resolving Caliber.
Basic Attack 4 akan mengonsumsi seluruh "Rocksteady Shield" Taoqi untuk memberikan "Resolving Caliber" dalam jumlah yang sama.
Selama Rocksteady Shield ada, saat karakter aktif diserang, 1 "Rocksteady Shield" akan dikonsumsi untuk memulihkan "Resolving Caliber".
Setelah Rocksteady Shield berakhir, seluruh "Rocksteady Shield" yang tersisa akan dikonsumsi untuk memberikan "Resolving Caliber" dalam jumlah yang sama.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonator yang masuk mendapat Amplify Resonance Skill DMG sebesar 38% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Forte Circuit Power Shift's Shield is increased by 40%.
description.id: Shield Forte Circuit Power Shift meningkat sebesar 40%.

description.en: The Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation Unmovable is increased by 20% and 20%, respectively.
description.id: Crit. Rate dan Crit. DMG Resonance Liberation Unmovable meningkat masing-masing sebesar 20% dan 20%.

description.en: The duration of Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield is extended to 30s.
description.id: Durasi Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield diperpanjang menjadi 30 dtk.

description.en: When Taoqi successfully triggers Heavy Attack Strategic Parry, she restores 25% HP and increases her DEF by 50% for 5s. This can be triggered once every 15s.
description.id: Saat Taoqi berhasil memicu Heavy Attack Strategic Parry, ia memulihkan 25% HP dan meningkatkan DEF-nya sebesar 50% selama 5 dtk. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 15 dtk.

description.en: The damage of Forte Circuit Power Shift is increased by 50%. When Forte Circuit Power Shift hits a target, restore 20 Resonance Energy.
description.id: Damage Forte Circuit Power Shift meningkat sebesar 50%. Saat Forte Circuit Power Shift mengenai target, memulihkan 20 Resonance Energy.

description.en: The damage of Taoqi's Basic Attack and Heavy Attack is increased by 40% while the Shield granted by Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield holds.
description.id: Damage Basic Attack dan Heavy Attack Taoqi meningkat sebesar 40% selama Shield dari Resonance Skill Rocksteady Shield masih bertahan.
